entries.title: Psalms 137:1
segments: ¶By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept When we remembered Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:2
segments: We hung our harps Upon the willows in the midst of it.

entries.title: Psalms 137:3
segments: For there those who carried us away captive asked of us a song, And those who plundered us [requested] mirth, [Saying], "Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion!"

entries.title: Psalms 137:4
segments: How shall we sing the LORD'S song In a foreign land?

entries.title: Psalms 137:5
segments: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget [its skill]!

entries.title: Psalms 137:6
segments: If I do not remember you, Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth-If I do not exalt Jerusalem Above my chief joy.

entries.title: Psalms 137:7
segments: ¶Remember, O LORD, against the sons of Edom The day of Jerusalem, Who said, "Raze [it], raze [it], To its very foundation!"

entries.title: Psalms 137:8
segments: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be destroyed, Happy the one who repays you as you have served us!

entries.title: Psalms 137:9
segments: Happy the one who takes and dashes Your little ones against the rock!
